title: Astryx: overview film
description: Meta’s open-source design system, rendered by Fluid. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 58 seconds: Astryx for TYPO3 v14. Six of 25 themes; A theme for a page and its subpages; Pricing in Matcha; Every theme, light and dark. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: Most design systems ship as React components, with a Node build and JavaScript on every page.
Astryx brings Meta’s open-source design system to TYPO3, with 250 elements and 25 themes.
Each theme changes fonts, colours and corners. Matcha even sets headings in handwriting.
A field in the page properties sets the theme for a page and everything below it.
Here, the Plans and Pricing chapter runs in Matcha.
Colour scheme and theme switch independently, so every theme also works in dark mode.
Astryx for TYPO3. Fluid on the server, with no build step.
